**Subject: Re: SSO on the Team plan**

Hi [Name],

Thanks for asking. We don't support SSO today, and it isn't available on the Team plan.

We're building SAML SSO now. It's planned for Q1 2027 and will be included only on our Enterprise plan. If SSO is a requirement for you, I can add you to the early-access list for Enterprise, or put you in touch with our team to talk through options.

In the meantime, the Team plan still includes [email/password sign-in, etc. — fill in as appropriate].

Best,
[Your name]

---

I based this on the 2026-10-20 decision (Ana Okafor and Priya Raman): SSO is Enterprise-only and ships Q1 2027, and we shouldn't promise it on Team. I offered an early-access list and a call, but I haven't confirmed either exists, so remove them if they don't. Fill in the placeholder for what Team does include. I'd also keep "Q1 2027" worded as a plan rather than a commitment.
